comment: Parameters 6 to 23, 26 and 27 hold the filter design: oversampling, the pole mix coefficients, the per-stage cutoff offsets, the distortion curves and the feedback path. None has a widget on Bascom's own panel; they are set from a preset or from the Bascom Expander, so they are untagged here. The default parameter values are mix coefficients A to D at 0 and E at 1, which is the plain four pole lowpass; the shipped presets are grouped as 01 Clean, 02 Diode_Resonance, 03 Diode_Resonance_Warm, 04 OverDriven_Resonance_Warm, 05 Diode_ladder and 06 Synth. Bascom has no appendContextMenu of its own, so its presets are reached through Rack's Preset submenu. configOutput is called twice on MAIN_OUTPUT, the second time with the name Right, so both output tooltips read Right; the right input is never configured and has no name.
